spans.s:
पौण्डरीक पौण्डरीक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्ड-
रीक), consisting of lotus-flowers; (अस्), m. a kind
of Soma sacrifice lasting twelve days (Ved.); a pa-
tronymic of Kṣema-dhṛtvan; (अम्), n., scil. कुष्-
ठ, a kind of leprosy; a species of plant (= प्र-
पौण्डरीक).
—पौण्डरीक-पद्धति, इस्, f., N.
of a ritual work containing the prayers used at the
Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

पौण्डर्य पौण्डर्य, अम्, n. a kind of drug
used as a remedy for diseased eyes (= पुण्डर्य,
q. v.).

पौण्ड्र पौण्ड्र, अस्, m. (fr. पुण्ड्र), a species
of sugar-cane of a pale straw colour; N. of a country
(said to include part of South Behar and Bengal);
N. of a king of this country (regarded as a son of
Vasu-deva); N. of the conch-shell of Bhīṣma; a
mark, sectarial mark; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people,
the inhabitants of the Pauṇḍra country.

पौण्ड्रक, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
= पौण्ड्र; (अस्), m. the pale straw-coloured
species of sugar-cane; epithet of a particular mixed
caste of hereditary sugar-boilers, (the son of a Vaiśya
by a woman of the distiller class; regarded as one of
the degraded races of Kṣatriyas, Manu

पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक, अस्, m. (probably) a king of
the Puṇḍras and Matsyas.

पौण्ड्रवत्स, आस्, m. pl. (fr. पुण्ड्र + वत्स),
N. of a school.

पौण्ड्रवर्धन, अम्, n., N. of a city, =
पुण्ड्र-वर्धन; (अस्), m., N. of a country, one
of the divisions of central India, Behar.

पौण्ड्रिक, अस्, m. a pale straw-coloured variety
of the sugar-cane; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

पौण्य पौण्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्य), up-
right, righteous, virtuous, deserving good treatment.
